2.9 of 5 from 8 ratings, 5 low; top cause: wrong answer about exports

## Numbers

## Top causes
1. Wrong answer about exports — 2 low ratings (Mon, Wed): both were told CSV export was not possible; it is.
2. Slow first reply — 2 low ratings (Tue, Wed): each waited days for a first reply; the public billing complaint (Community replies, 4 days unanswered) says the same.

- "Was told there is no CSV export. There is. Found it myself." — J., Wed
- "Quick, clear, fixed in one go." — A., Tue
